result.brief: 提出统一的 world-actor-critic 模型，在单阶段预训练中联合学习动作条件世界模型、actor 与 critic，用视觉潜空间预测端点状态与奖励，实现无需生成中间帧的高效想象 rollout 与策略改进。
result.reason: Unified world-actor-critic with action-conditioned latent world model and shared representation for dexterous manipulation; main contribution is embodied policy/world modeling, so secondary application direction.
